mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dsh_input_deliveries (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, input_execution_uuid, input_id, ack_subject, cleanup_job_uuid, status) SELECT organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, uuid, input_id, #{ackSubject,sensitive=true}, (SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{cleanupJobID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'), CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'waiting' END FROM dsh_input_executions WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID} ON CONFLICT (organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, input_id) DO UPDATE SET ack_subject = EXCLUDED.ack_subject, cleanup_job_uuid = EXCLUDED.cleanup_job_uuid, status = EXCLUDED.status, delivered_at = NOW(), attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(), lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE dsh_input_deliveries.ack_subject IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.ack_subject
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dsh_input_deliveries WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID}
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_input_deliveries SET status = 'pending', next_attempt_at = NOW() WHERE AND input_id = #{inputID} AND status = 'waiting'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dsh_input_deliveries WHERE uuid IN ( SELECT uuid FROM dsh_input_deliveries WHERE status = 'discarded' AND delivered_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY uuid LIMIT 256 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED )
mapper.update: UPDATE dsh_input_deliveries AS d SET status = 'discarded', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE d.status IN ('waiting', 'pending') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM code_sessions AS c JOIN sessions AS s ON s.uuid = c.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = c.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = c.workspace_uuid WHERE c.uuid = d.code_session_uuid AND c.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND c.workspace_uuid = d.workspace_uuid AND c.status = 'active' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.archived_at IS NULL AND s.status != 'terminated' )

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT uuid FROM dsh_input_deliveries WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= NOW() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= NOW()) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, uuid LIMIT 16 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE dsh_input_deliveries AS d SET lease_token = gen_random_uuid(), lease_until = NOW() + INTERVAL '30 seconds' FROM candidates AS c WHERE d.uuid = c.uuid RETURNING d.uuid, d.organization_uuid, d.workspace_uuid, d.code_session_uuid, d.input_id, d.ack_subject, d.cleanup_job_uuid, d.status, d.attempts, d.lease_token
